import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();

        int at_pos = s.indexOf("at", 1);
        if (at_pos != -1) {
            s = s.substring(0, at_pos) + "@" + s.substring(at_pos + 2);
        }

        int search_pos = 1;
        while (true) {
            int dot_pos = s.indexOf("dot", search_pos);
            if (dot_pos == -1 || dot_pos > s.length() - 4) break;
            s = s.substring(0, dot_pos) + "." + s.substring(dot_pos + 3);
            search_pos = dot_pos + 1;
        }

        System.out.print(s);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
